brand.name: SaVi Tech
brand.heroLede: Website design, development, landing pages, and digital products. Done carefully, and handed over clean.
brand.bandText: A small creative technology studio. Sahara Banu, founder. Vijay Prasad, co-founder. The work is websites, interfaces, and the digital products around them.
aboutParagraphs: SaVi Technologies is a creative technology company. The work covers website design, web development, landing pages, UI and UX, app development, and related digital solutions.
The name is the two people and the work. Sa is Sahara. Vi is Vijay. Tech is technology. Sahara Banu is the founder. Vijay Prasad is the co-founder.
SaVi Tech is the brand name. SaVi Technologies is the business name.
brand.aboutNote: SaVi Tech is Sahara and Vijay, working together in technology.
brand.servicesIntro: Clear scopes. Practical builds. If something sits outside the work, we say so.
brand.teamIntro: SaVi is a small studio. These are the two people behind it.
brand.contactIntro: A short note is enough. We reply with a straight answer about fit, timing, and next steps.

services.title: Website design
services.summary: Page structure, type, and a visual system that stays quiet and readable.
services.detail: Company sites and marketing sites, from the first layout through to a design that can be built as drawn.

services.title: Web development
services.summary: Front-end builds that match the design and stay easy to change later.
services.detail: HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Clean structure. No stack you do not need.

services.title: Landing pages
services.summary: One page with one job: explain the offer and make the next step obvious.
services.detail: Campaign pages, launches, and straightforward pages for a single product or service.

services.title: UI / UX
services.summary: Interfaces people can move through without a tour.
services.detail: Flows, screens, and the small decisions that make a product feel finished.

services.title: App development
services.summary: Screens and front-ends for products that need more than a brochure site.
services.detail: We design the interface and, where it fits the scope, build the front end.

services.title: Digital solutions
services.summary: Smaller technical work that sits beside a site: forms, content, simple tools.
services.detail: Scoped before it starts. If it is not a fit, we will tell you.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: We agree what the page has to do, then shape the layout and the words around that.

steps.title: Develop
steps.text: We build it in the open: readable code, real content, and room to edit later.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.text: You get the finished site, the files, and a short handover.
